kudos.definition: n an expression of approval and commendation

kudu.definition: n. either of two spiral-horned antelopes of the African bush

kudzu.definition: n. fast-growing vine from eastern Asia having tuberous starchy roots and hairy trifoliate leaves and racemes of purple flowers followed by long hairy pods containing many seeds; grown for fodder and forage and root starch; widespread in the southern United States

kugel.translation: n. 一种烤制的布丁; 形状类似面条; 由土豆、鸡蛋和调味类做成的传统食品; （姓氏）库高

kumquat.translation: n. 金橘, 金钱桔树
kumquat.definition:
n. any of several trees or shrubs of the genus Fortunella bearing small orange-colored edible fruits with thick sweet-flavored skin and sour pulp
n. small oval citrus fruit with thin sweet rind and very acid pulp

kundalini.translation: n. (瑜伽教理中的)生命力(据认为蜷伏在尾椎部,当上升至脑时,即激发悟道)

kurd.definition: n. a member of a largely pastoral Islamic people who live in Kurdistan; the largest ethnic group without their own state

kurdish.translation:
a. 库尔德人的
n. 库尔德语
kurdish.definition:
n. an Iranian language spoken in Turkey and Iran and Iraq and Syria and Russia
a. of or relating to Kurdistan or the Kurds or their language and culture

kurta.translation: n. (=khurta)(印度人穿的)无领长袖衬衫
kurta.definition: n. a loose collarless shirt worn by many people on the Indian subcontinent (usually with a salwar or churidars or pyjama)

kurtosis.translation:
n. 峰态, 峭度
[计] 峭度, 峰度

kuwaiti.translation:
a. 科威特的, 科威特人的
n. 科威特人
kuwaiti.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Kuwait
a. of or relating to the kingdom of Kuwait or its people
a. of or relating to the capital of Kuwait or its residents

kymograph.translation:
n. 波动曲线记录仪
[医] 记波[纹]器
kymograph.definition: n. scientific instrument consisting of a rotating drum holding paper on which a stylus traces a continuous record (as of breathing or blood pressure)
